description: ABB's IE4 Super Premium Efficiency Cast iron motors deliver the highest efficiency currently available in the market. They are based on the robust and well-proven induction platform, meeting IE4 requirements without using permanent magnets.
differentiators: IE4 Super Premium Efficiency without permanent magnets
Robust cast iron construction suitable for industrial environments

description: Siemens SIMOTICS SD 1LE5 standard motors are next generation severe duty motors with IE3 Premium Efficiency, designed for reliable operation in demanding environments with a robust cast-iron series.

The W22 motors feature a cast iron frame, flexible mounting, solid feet, and lower noise levels. They offer excellent cost effectiveness and superior efficiency levels for a great variety of industrial applications.
differentiators: Flexible mounting options with solid and whole feet
Lower noise levels and operating temperatures
Superior efficiency for reduced energy consumption
